ctx.x: Why in the 60s did you write under the name Naomi Neville? Naomi Neville. Naomi.

That's my mother's maiden name. out in Tibidore and Shriburri pronounced it John Neville, which was my grandfather. I had, when mother-in-law was written and things before that, I was underage. And there were people that would come through town and collect a lot of things, masters, and they'd sell them out to different companies. And I was a product of that for a while. It's just not so terrible. It just was a way of doing things at that time. And I was out on a particular label, which was an alright label. But…
Who has all the old Minute material, like all the old tapes of that?
